order_algorithm: Sort P1..P5 by SHA256('20261015:' + block); first three are blocking-first, other two lookahead-first; execute blocks P1..P5
primary_estimand: Median across the five block-level log ratios log(lookahead/blocking), each arm represented by its median of five measured-QA client E2E seconds; report exp(median) and 1-exp(median). TTFT and quality-qualified goodput use the same block pairing as prespecified secondary outcomes.
goodput: Per-arm sum of actual completion_tokens from measured eligible QA / sum of actual client request_e2e_seconds for all five measured QA slots. Only complete quality/custody-qualified arms get a number; partial/failed/unissued arms remain null, not zero latency or silently excluded.
interval: Exact enumerated paired-block bootstrap, resample five block log ratios with replacement (5^5=3125), nearest-rank 2.5%/97.5% percentiles, exp endpoints. Only if all five pairs qualify; otherwise no aggregate estimate or interval. Exploratory descriptive n=5, not coverage-guaranteed confidence or significance.
failure_policy: STOP new admission on any gate, timeout, stale hash, unknown or pending custody, failed text/usage/actual-ID/trace/counter/NFS gate or post-idle. Never drop/replace a pair. Retain five paired blocks, ten lifecycles, 120 requests and 50 measured QA, including censored and unissued slots. Cancellation retains maintained subreaper cleanup authority.

profiling.reason: Ordinary direct-child capture is maintained; official nsys requires its separately maintained authenticated collector adapter. No wrapping nsys around the server or weakening direct-child custody here.
profiling.acceptance: Official nsys pinned binary/help/version and full export, actual PID/UUID/request windows, process collector custody and loss diagnostics; graph-aware full-export completeness audit layered over bidirectional API/activity correlation. Correlation closure alone is not completeness. Host NVTX spans are not GPU execution/overlap evidence.
profiling.privacy: Fixed span names plus unsigned numeric identities/counts only; no prompt/text/path/env/secrets in NVTX

quality_tolerances.ordinary_vs_diagnostic_logits: exact F32-LE SHA256 plus shapes and greedy IDs

claim_limits: Exploratory paired instrumented TP1/PP1/EP1 serial repeated-QA study, not SOTA/significance/power/general throughput
Fresh servers are not cold storage or independent NFS/page-cache samples
NFS observations are shared client deltas, not NAS disk bytes
Logical host reservations exclude OS/TLS/allocator headroom; sampled PSS/device memory are not hard partitions or exact peaks
NVTX OFF does not remove DEBUG/TRACE, sampler or compiled instrumentation overhead
Owner-local quiescent close may retain residency; universal final resource release remains unverified
